newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-DONATO GOAL LIFTS DEPORTIVO LEVEL WITH REAL MADRID.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-DONATO GOAL LIFTS DEPORTIVO LEVEL WITH REAL MADRID.

text.p: A superb goal by Brazilian midfielder Donato gave Deportivo Coruna a 1-0 victory over Real Sociedad on Sunday, leaving them level on points with second-placed Real Madrid.
Donato's viciously swerving 35-metre shot in the 20th minute gave goalkeeper Alberto Lopez no chance.
"The goal was worth the match," said Deportivo chairman Augusto Lendoiro, whose side suffered heavy Real Sociedad pressure in the final minutes.
Deportivo stay in third place on goal difference behind Real Madrid who slipped four points behind leaders Barcelona after Saturday's goalless draw with Tenerife.
Barcelona had Brazilian striker Ronaldo, who scored an remarkable hat-trick, to thank for their 3-2 win over Valencia.
